summary: Tested 5 fixes for Manufacturing ERP. All fixes verified working correctly via backend API tests and frontend UI tests.

Fix 4: DC Print shows proper Job Work Part Details table - VERIFIED. Print preview contains 'Job Work Part Details' section with Sl. No., Part, QTY, Charges, Total columns and 'Raw Material Issued' section

Fix 5: BOM page shows only FG BOMs as top-level - VERIFIED. Only FG-001 Hydraulic Press 50T shown as top-level BOM group. SA-001, SA-002 appear as expandable children in the tree, not as separate top-level sections
